# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the source map, actual calculation ownership, Karoo lifecycle, Glance constraints and verification rules. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for development, CI limitations and the technical improvement plan.

Use those documents as the canonical project guidance. Do not duplicate architecture, SDK versions or sizing rules here. Validate available APIs against the project's resolved `karoo-ext` version. Preserve ride behavior and unrelated work; do not create Markdown reports for individual fixes, or commit without user authorization and the required verification.
